title: DocSync Decision Log Entry
description: Written once per proposal decision (approve/reject/defer). Append-only.

proposal_id.description: PROP-* ID of the proposal this entry resolves

resolved_by.description: Agent ID or human identifier who made the decision

rationale.description: Free-text reason. Required for rejected and deferred. Optional for approved.

applied_commit.description: Git SHA of the commit that applied the doc change. Required when decision=approved.

proposal_snapshot.description: Frozen copy of the proposal at decision time for audit purposes
